definitions.first_reliable_decoding_layer: smallest measured layer with linear accuracy>0.5 at a checkpoint and the next registered checkpoint
definitions.fourier_emergence: not classified because no frozen registered Fourier R2 threshold exists
definitions.normalized_onset_depth: measured layer index divided by six Transformer blocks
definitions.registered_establishment: first probe checkpoint with full-support R<0.1, center accuracy>0.9, and layer-6 linear accuracy>0.9
definitions.registered_onset: first probe checkpoint with full-support R<0.9 and layer-6 linear accuracy>0.5, with both retained at the next registered probe checkpoint

interpretation_limits: Representation accessibility is measured only at layers 0, 3, and 6.
Probe associations do not establish a causal mediator.
project: Project Kepler v1.3 Transition Dynamics Audit

fourier_before_R_decrease.reason: No registered Fourier R2 threshold exists; continuous Fourier curves are reported without post-hoc dichotomization.
